update.releaseNotes:
v5.9.47 - Decision Report Viewer, Career Planner, training stat-bias features, Discord run history
New --- - Decision Report Viewer: import Trackblazer decision logs and browse turn-by-turn cards explaining each bot choice - Opt-in Career Planner (Training Settings): soft stat-target bias inferred from your equipped support deck composition - Always-on Running-Style Stat Bias: nudges stat targets toward what actually matters in-race for the trainee's preferred running style - Opt-in Energy Banking (Training Settings): rest instead of training once energy is low and a mandatory race is coming up soon - Opt-in Goal Race Stat Reallocation (Training Settings): temporarily targets the upcoming mandatory race's actual distance instead of your preferred distance - Quality breakdown and run history comparison in Discord notifications
Trackblazer --- - Race selection weights trainee aptitude (surface/distance B+) - Phase-aware Good-Luck Charm thresholds (tighter Junior, relaxed Finale) - Phase- and inventory-aware energy, consecutive-race, and mood-recovery logic
Fixes --- - Owned support deck auto-equip now matches the actual 3x2 career-selection grid and friend slot coordinates - Fixed stale "four slots" copy in the owned-support auto-equip setting - Reverted a race prep skip-detection change that wasn't working reliably, back to the prior known-good behavior
